policy: Explicit requires a strong keyword in the effective product description. Name-only AI mentions are downgraded.
AI tags, AI names and .ai website domains are weak signals, not proof.
Only Antler records whose description equals name use location as effective description.
Automation, smart, algorithms, data analytics and IoT alone do not establish AI relevance.
Possible signals are recall candidates and may include unrelated travel agents, non-AI robots or medical abbreviations.
No evidence means no signal in available fields, not proof of being non-AI. No semantic or external verification is performed.
